name: Beeswarm Plot
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: How marker genes are expressed across cell types or niches, one swarm of cells per group.

params.name: field
params.label: Groups
params.help:
Selects the annotation whose groups form the rows: cell types, niches or any other categorical column.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: genes
params.label: Genes
params.help:
Selects the genes that form the columns.
Opens on the 20 genes detected in the most cells, the Marker Dot Plot’s Top markers. Search to add genes, or remove them; left empty, the plot uses those 20.

params.name: coarse
params.label: Coarse groups
params.help:
Adds a second, broader annotation as an outer colour strip and orders the rows by it; each group takes the coarse group most of its cells belong to.
The same column as Groups draws no outer strip.

params.name: threshold
params.label: Expression threshold
params.help:
Leaves cells at or below this log1p(CP10K) out of the swarms; 0 keeps every cell that detects the gene.
The colours always count every cell of a group.

params.name: cmap
params.label: Colormap
params.help: Colours the mean expression z-score with the colormaps the viewer offers for gene expression.
